episodes.title: EPSTEIN SURVIVORS: “Vote NO On The Confirmation of Blanche!”
episodes.description:
Epstein survivors and legislative advocates Lara Blume McGee and Sharlene Rochard join Tim Dickinson to speak out against the Senate confirmation of Trump Attorney General nominee Todd Blanche.

McGee and Rochard detail their dehumanizing meeting with Todd Blanche, who oversaw the botched redaction of the Epstein files that exposed survivors while shielding powerful accomplices. They explain why Blanche’s admission that he has not read the files points to an active cover-up, and why they are taking the 3.5 million page Trump-Epstein Memorial Bookmobile on a nationwide tour to demand full transparency and justice.

McGee and Rochard break down their meetings on Capitol Hill with Senate leadership, the power of their survivor sisterhood, and their direct message to senators considering Blanche's nomination for America's top legal post.
